text:
Rajdeep Ghosh
grajdeep457@gmail.com

| LinkedIn

Results-driven MIS Analyst (Data Analyst - Reporting & Automation) with expertise in SQL, Excel, Power BI, and data automation 
using Google Sheets and Apps Script. Proven ability to manage large datasets, uncover trends, and deliver data-driven insights to 
optimize business performance.
SKILLS
Tools: Excel (Advanced) (Power Query, Pivot Tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP), MS SQL Server, MySQL Workbench, Microsoft Fabric,
Power BI, Python (NumPy, Pandas, Matplotlib)
Analytical Skills: Data Cleaning, Data Wrangling, A/B Testing (Basics), Data Analysis, Data Visualization, Data Modelling, Data
Manipulation, ETL Process
Cloud: Microsoft Azure, AWS
PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
MIS Analyst, Durga Bearings Pvt Ltd 10/2025 – Present
•Automated data collection, cleaning, and transformation workflows using Google Sheets, Forms, Excel, and Apps Script, reducing 
manual effort by ~40–50% and ensuring high-quality, analysis-ready data.
•Built interactive dashboards in Microsoft Power BI to track and analyze key business metrics, improving reporting efficiency and 
accelerating decision-making by ~30%.
•Analyzed and structured large datasets to identify trends, optimize processes, and implement automated tracking and 
notification systems, reducing errors by ~25% and enhancing operational efficiency.
Business Development Intern, Acmegrade 06/2024 – 08/2024
•Structured and maintained lead datasets for 500+ prospects, improving follow-up accuracy by 20%.
•Built weekly Excel MIS dashboards tracking conversion rates, KPIs, and response trends, boosting sales performance by 12%. 
Identified top-performing outreach methods through trend analysis, contributing to a 10% increase in lead-to-client conversions.
•Collaborated with team members to enhance reporting accuracy and streamline workflows.
PROJECTS
Toy Store Analysis 
•Built a 5 page Power BI dashboard analyzing 473K+ sessions, 32K+ orders, and $1.94M revenue, delivering insights across 
customer funnel, marketing performance, product analytics, and user behavior
•Developed a star schema data model and wrote advanced DAX measures (conversion rate, funnel drop-off, margin %, repeat user 
segmentation) to ensure accurate, scalable analysis
•Conducted end-to-end data analysis to identify key trends, including ~64% cart stage drop-off, 3× higher desktop vs mobile 
conversion, and higher conversion from repeat users, enabling data-driven decision-making
Global Electronics Sale Analysis 
•Built a Power BI dashboard (62K+ records, $57M revenue) using star schema + DAX, enabling cross-functional analysis of sales, 
customers, and store performance.
•Created 20+ KPIs revealing 52% US revenue dependency and low 20% online share, influencing strategic decisions on market 
diversification and ecommerce growth.
•Identified $22.9M top customer segment and 39% churn, translating data into actionable strategies for retention and revenue 
optimization.
Mexican Toy Sales Analysis 
•Developed a 4-page Power BI dashboard analyzing ~50M+ sales data across 5 integrated datasets, leveraging a star schema data 
model to enable scalable reporting on sales, inventory, product, and store performance
•Built 10+ DAX measures and KPIs (e.g., Total Sales, Profit, Contribution %, Inventory Risk), uncovering key insights such as top 
~20% products driving majority of revenue and identification of low-stock risk items
•Performed data transformation using Power Query and designed 15+ interactive visuals with slicers, enabling dynamic analysis 
of regional sales trends, product performance, and demand-supply gaps
CERTIFICATES
The Ultimate MySQL Bootcamp - Udemy 
March 30, 2025
Problem Solving (Intermediate) - HackerRank 
March 31, 2025
EDUCATION
B.Tech in Information Technology, KIIT University 06/2020 – 05/2024 | Bhubaneswar, Odisha
'CGPA' - 7.86
